name: Call cancelled
description: A closing call is cancelled before its start (not rescheduled: a reschedule moves the appointment and never fires this; a cancel after the start, a host clearing a no-show's slot, is not a cancel and the filed outcome stands, D73). Both pipeline cards move to their cancelled stage, the appointment date comes off the contact, the closer gets a rebook task due in a day, stat-cancelled replaces the booked tags, the slot's Sales Call record is marked cancelled (never deleted or reused), and the team gets a Slack note with who cancelled and why.
